title: Order Service DB Pool Starvation after Deploy v1.9.4
symptoms: Database timeout on Postgres write replicas
Connection queue backed up with 180 waiting threads
root_cause: Unindexed foreign key query combined with default max_connections=40 starved pool on surge traffic.
resolution: Rolled back deployment v1.9.4 and increased PostgreSQL connection pool limits to 120 sockets.
engineer_feedback: Rollback and pool increase quickly restored order placement SLAs.
